rows.note: This is the all-purpose Hong Kong Cantonese term for a restaurant menu and also works for a banquet menu.

example.english: The menu at this restaurant is several pages long.
example.traditional: 呢間酒樓嘅餐牌有成幾頁。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 zau2 lau4 ge3 caan1 paai2 jau5 seng4 gei2 jip6

rows.note: Use this for a computer or app menu from which the user selects an operation.

example.english: Just choose the language from the settings menu.
example.traditional: 你喺設定嘅選單揀返語言就得。
example.jyutping: nei5 hai2 cit3 ding6 ge3 syun2 daan1 gaan2 faan1 jyu5 jin4 zau6 dak1

rows.note: Use this mainly for the planned dishes at a banquet, especially in written or more formal contexts rather than for an ordinary restaurant menu.

example.english: The menu for the wedding banquet has already been printed.
example.traditional: 婚宴嘅菜單已經印好喇。
example.jyutping: fan1 jin3 ge3 coi3 daan1 ji5 ging1 jan3 hou2 laa3
